metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the three stalls, Harrison at the White Greyhound, and a page at home after Titus.

yesterday: Venus moves. Lucrece is respected. He has scarce a dozen of Lucrece left.
You told him you had been busy with a comedy.
The Walk talked of a wedding at Greenwich on Sunday. You left it as news.
Tomorrow Hilary term opens. You are not cast in Two Gents at two.
